about.title: Two windows and a long table
about.lead: Fern & Filter opened in 2019 under the green awning on NW Thimbleberry. We roast across the river on Mondays and carry the beans back the same afternoon.
about.summary: Fern & Filter is a specialty coffee bar on NW Thimbleberry Avenue in Portland, Oregon. It roasts its Awning house blend and one monthly single origin every Monday, and is open seven days a week.
about.sourcingBody: The Awning blend is Brazil and Colombia, bought from the same two farms every year so it tastes the same in every bag. The single origin is where we take chances: one lot a month, picked by cupping samples at the long table. We are not perfect about sourcing, but we are deliberate.
about.nameBody: The fern is Portland: it grows everywhere and asks for very little. The filter is the work: taking something raw and turning it into something worth slowing down for.
about.roastBody: Light to medium, every Monday, in a small roastery in southeast Portland. The beans rest two days, so Monday's roast is Wednesday's espresso. The single origin changes on the first of the month, and the bag on the shelf says which one it is.
about.imageAlt: Morning light across the counter and the shelf of house-roasted beans
